content.comment_body: Hello, I'm planning to update a program that currently controls the inverter speed using keyboard keys. I want to add two preset speeds activated by function keys, but also keep the ability to fine-tune whichever preset is active. Any advice or help on how to achieve this would be appreciated. I tried uploading the programs as a zip file, but couldn't upload in any format.
Since last Friday, there have been issues attaching files to forum posts. Please upload your files to a hosting service and share the download link.
Hi, I have provided a link and included both the preset speed program and the current program. My goal is to merge the two. [url] Regards.

If I understand correctly, you want to toggle between two fixed setpoints while still allowing fine adjustments. Is that right? If so, you need two setpoint adjusters, both managed through an analogue multiplexer. You've already worked with setpoint adjusters.
Thank you so much, that's exactly what I needed. Appreciate your help.
You've decided that changes in the 65% range are only allowed from 60% to 70%, and for the 85% range from 80% to 90%, correct?
Thanks, I'll update the values before going live.

analysis.insight_summary: The main objective is to adapt inverter speed control for two preset speeds, selectable via function keys, with adjustable setpoints. The user seeks straightforward guidance for integrating this functionality while preserving flexibility. Community support effectively validates their method and offers a practical design, swiftly resolving the user's needs.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to implement two function-key-accessible setpoints for inverter speed, with individual fine adjustment for each. They are looking for clear, actionable integration advice from the community.
